issue: Entry not persisted after page reload
actual: Created entry "Test Entry for Verification" appeared immediately in table (6 entries total), but after page reload, only 5 original entries remain and the newly created entry is gone.
evidence: Entry created with Task Name, Priority 5, Due Date Dec 25 2026, and Completed checkbox checked. Entry showed in table with entry count 6/6. After reload at same URL, entry count reverted to 5 and new entry missing.
Successfully added new "Status" field with Text type. Field appears in table column header and in all data rows with "—" as empty value placeholder.

Successfully entered text ("Data Type Test Entry"), number (7), date (Sep 15 2026), checkbox (No/unchecked), and text (Active). All values display correctly in both table and card views with proper formatting.
Switched from table to card view and back to table view. All 6 entries remain present with identical field values and formatting in both views.

Table view sorted by Priority (ascending) showing 1,1,2,2,3,7. Switched to card view and sorted by Due Date (ascending). Switched back to table view - it retained Priority sort. Card view retained Due Date sort when revisited.
Search for "marketing" returned 1 matching entry with updated count "1 entry matching". Search for "Priority" returned 0 matching entries. Clear button works and restores all 6 entries.

When sort is cleared, "Drag entries to reorder" message appears. Each table row shows drag handle button with aria-roledescription="sortable". Card view also displays same message when no sort is active.
Priority field uses HTML input[type=number], which prevents non-numeric text input. Attempting to type "abc" resulted in browser validation error blocking the input.
Due Date field uses HTML input[type=date], which provides native date validation. Attempting to enter "invalid-date" resulted in validation error blocking the input (Malformed value).
When sorted by Priority (descending), all 6 entries remained with original values intact. Entry count displayed as "6 entries". Sorting only changed visual order, not data.
Search for "marketing" showed 1 matching entry. Search for "Priority" showed 0 matching entries. Clear button restored all 6 entries without data loss.
Table and card views display identical values: Priority (1,2,3,7), Dates (Jan 15-25, Sep 15 - formatted consistently), Checkbox states ("Yes"/"No"), empty Status shows "—" in both views.
Completed checkbox states displayed as "Yes" (checked) and "No" (unchecked) with icons in both table and card views. States are clearly distinguishable.

In Fields dialog, field types displayed with clear labels: Text, Number, Date, Checkbox. Entry form provides appropriate controls for each type (spinbutton for number, date picker for date, checkbox for boolean).
Quick search for "marketing" matched the text field value "Review marketing materials". Search appears to match against displayed field values, not just raw internal values.

Clicking Priority in sort menu immediately reordered table by Priority, showing "Sorted by Priority (ascending)". Active sort field identified in button text. App remains fully usable with sort applied.

Quick search acts as filtering mechanism. Entering search query filters entries by matching field values. Search shows entry count and clear button restores all entries. This provides field-level filtering (matching across field values).

evidence: Explored main toolbar (Fields, Sort, Table/Cards, Add Entry buttons), Fields dialog, and search for visible import controls. No import UI element was located. Feature may exist in code but is not accessible through the UI.
